in_marathi.name: Nithya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nithya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nithya refers to the eternal, continuous, and unchanging nature of the universe and the divine. It is derived from the Sanskrit root 'nith' meaning 'eternal'.
